description.text: Mega Battle Deck 60: M Charizard-EX, a ready-built 60-card deck released on 15 March 2014 and built around Charizard-EX and its Mega Evolution M Charizard-EX, as Mega Charizard Y. It is rich in strong cards, reprints among them, such as Professor Sycamore, Ultra Ball and Pal Pad, which some players bought it for. A playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, a rule book and a battle master guide came with it.
